Variants.Content: War with Geats divides people between land warnings and vessels. Repair, water and landings set endurance; lost ships also harm households.

War with Geats divides people between vessels and land defence. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Repair, fresh water and landings set operational duration.
